Today in Nepal: five stories you should know.

1. Panel recommends declaring 3,915 missing in flood dead
2. Missing Malaysia fraud case file found, handed to CIB
3. Government to run special operation on manpower agencies
4. One Nepali killed, three injured in Saudi attack
5. UK student visa refusal rate highest in a decade

नेपालमा आज:
१. ३,९१५ बेपत्तालाई मृत घोषणा गर्न समिति सिफारिस
२. हराएको मलेसिया ठगी मुद्दाको फाइल फेला
३. म्यानपावर एजेन्सीमाथि विशेष अभियान
४. साउदी आक्रमणमा एक नेपालीको मृत्यु
५. बेलायत विद्यार्थी भिसा अस्वीकृति दशककै उच्च

Which story matters most to you today?
